Text:
[II] We do not know what to pray for, but the Holy Spirit intercedes for us with unutterable groanings. In faith and need, we ask:
[IR] Holy Spirit intercede for us.
[I1] Christ, divine Shepherd, give wisdom and guidance to our shepherds,
[I2] that they may surely lead your flock to salvation.
[I1] You who dwell in the most high place and abound in mercy,
[I2] look after the needy and poor living within your creation..
[I1] Who, through the work of the Holy Spirit, was conceived by the Virgin Mary,
[I2] honor and preserve all who have committed to a celibate life.
[I1] You, our Priest, who praises the Father in the Holy Spirit:
[I2] unite all people in Your praise.
[I1] May the dead enter into their glorious freedom as children of God
[I2] and find their bodies fully redeemed.
